description: Built with everyday practicality and comfort, our Crossbody Day Bag keeps your possessions close to you, right where you need them. Compact and designed to fit comfortably between your shoulder blades, this crossbody organizer bag has a 2L capacity that is ideal for travel and measures 8 inch x 5.5 inch x 3 inch. On-the-Go Ruggedness: Designed to stay with you every step of the way, the travel bag is made with a robust 1000D nylon construction that easily withstands any environment. This belt bag is a must-have for traveling, commuting, concert-going, adventuring, and more. Stay Organized: The crossbody bag offers substantial storage space inside the main compartment for EDC essentials, such as a phone and wallet. The 3 mesh pockets are perfect for carrying small items, while the internal clip is great for securing keys or accessories. Safe & Secure Zipper Closures: The main compartment utilizes a two-way zipper that opens at both ends for quick and easy access. In addition, the lightweight organizer bag features 2 exterior zipper pockets on the front and back for paperwork, cash, earbuds, chargers, and more. Various Carry Options: This versatile belt bag uses an adjustable nylon strap with a side release buckle that extends up to 46 inches, allowing you to wear it across your body as crossbody bag or around your waist as a fanny pack.
